title: K-flat counit automorphism factorization
statement: Let f:Z→Y be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with the derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] of O_Z-modules and O_Y-modules recorded in a common localization universe. Let F be derived pullback [def-pc-derived-pullback], let H be the homotopy functor induced by additive termwise tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback], and write Qh for localization. Suppose ε₀ and ε are natural transformations Qh_Y⋙F→H⋙Qh_Z, each invertible at every K-flat representative [def-pc-kflat-complex]. There exists a natural automorphism a of Qh_Y⋙F such that a.hom≫ε₀=ε.

proof.text: Extract the recorded universal counit δ and its K-flat invertibility from exists_derivedPullback. Identify its termwise pullback functor with tensorPullback using the recorded object and map equalities. Use Functor.leftDerivedLift to lift ε₀ and ε to natural endomorphisms t₀ and t of derived pullback; leftDerived_fac supplies their factorization equations.

At a K-flat representative the factorization equation and invertibility of δ and the supplied counit imply invertibility of each lift. For an arbitrary derived object, choose a complex representative and a K-flat resolution. Localization inverts its augmentation. Transport invertibility along the resulting isomorphism by NatTrans.isIso_app_iff_of_iso, and apply NatTrans.isIso_iff_isIso_app.
Whisker t followed by the inverse of t₀ with Qh. This is a natural automorphism a. The factorization equations and inverse cancellation prove a.hom≫ε₀=ε.
